Slayer
Advertisement:
"The slayer was originally born from Lorencia and was reincarnated through experiments in Kundun which turned her into a half-human half-bat demi-human. 1896 of Lugard's calendar, the demi-human experiment was discovered by Kundun's forces in Kanturu. To increase the power of their forces, they use the experiment to create demi-humans. The slayer is the first successful demi-human created from the experiment."

Quick Facts
Starts in Lorencia.
Tier 1 Class: a beginner character.
Pay to play: requires a WCoin purchase.
Unlocked: no prerequisites required.
+5 stat points per character level.
+6 stat points per level after Hero Status quest.
Strength focus creates an offensive build.
Agility focus creates an defensive build.
Class Specialization
Each character has unique specialization bonuses.
Muun Bonus - starts with a Muun item.
Agility Bonus - additional ATK DMG & DEF Rate:
Less than 1,500 AGI: +0% ~ +10%
1,501 ~ 2,000 AGI: +10% ~ +30%
More than 2,001 AGI: +30% ~ +45%
Party Set Bonus - increased EXP gain:
Slayer
Dark Knight
Summoner
Class Evolution
All characters evolve through a series of classes after reaching a specific character level and after completing main quests.
1st: Slayer
Stops gaining EXP at Level 400.
Evolves into Royal Slayer.
2nd: Royal Slayer
Unlocked by:
Reaching Character Level 150.
Completing the 2nd Class Upgrade quest.
Stops gaining EXP at Level 400.
Evolves into Master Slayer.
3rd: Master Slayer
Unlocked by:
Reaching Character Level 400.
Completing the 3rd Class Upgrade quest.
Unlocks the Master Skill Tree.
Stops gaining EXP at Level 800.
Evolves into Slaughterer.
4th: Slaughterer
Unlocked by:
Reaching Character Level 800.
Completing the 4th Class Upgrade quest.
Unlocks the Skill Enhancement Tree.
Stops gaining EXP at Level 1450.
